## Three-Asset Portfolio Series (2023–2025) {#sec-data-portfolios-2025}

These data document weekly simple returns and adjusted prices for three
exchange-traded funds—a U.S. equity market fund (SPY), an international
developed-markets equity fund (EFA), and a long-term U.S. Treasury bond fund
(TLT)—alongside a contemporaneous weekly risk-free rate, covering the period
September 30, 2023 to September 29, 2025. The three funds were chosen for the
portfolio construction material in the course notes: over this window they had
nearly identical volatility but quite different mean returns, and the two
equity funds are strongly correlated with each other while the bond fund is
nearly uncorrelated with both. Prices are sourced from Yahoo Finance and
converted to weekly simple returns using split- and dividend-adjusted closing
prices.

The dataset ships as a single file, `portfolios.csv`, containing the weekly
returns, the risk-free rate, and the aligned weekly adjusted closing prices.
The rows sit on the same Friday grid as the broader weekly asset returns panel
(@sec-data-returns-2025), so the two datasets can be joined on `date`; the
`SPY` column here is the same series as that dataset's `market` column.

**Provenance.** Adjusted daily closing prices were retrieved from Yahoo Finance
via the `tidyquant` R package. The data request covers September 30, 2023 to
September 29, 2025 (`start_date` and `end_date` as set in `data_extract.R`).
The risk-free rate is proxied by the 13-week U.S. Treasury bill
secondary-market yield (`^IRX`), converted from an annualized percentage to a
weekly decimal rate by dividing by 100 and then by 52; forward-filling patches
any holiday gaps in that series. Price columns record the last available split-
and dividend-adjusted daily close on or before each weekly return date, so
prices and returns are aligned on the same Friday grid. Yahoo Finance terms of
use restrict redistribution of raw price data; this assembled dataset is
intended for educational use. See @portfolios-2025 for retrieval details.

### Variables {.unnumbered}

| Variable | Type | Unit / Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | Discrete (date) | YYYY-MM-DD | End-of-week date corresponding to the Friday close used by `tq_transmute()` with `period = "weekly"`. |
| `SPY` | Continuous | proportion | Weekly simple return on SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust), a proxy for the U.S. stock market. |
| `EFA` | Continuous | proportion | Weekly simple return on EFA (iShares MSCI EAFE ETF), a proxy for developed stock markets outside the U.S. |
| `TLT` | Continuous | proportion | Weekly simple return on TLT (iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF), a proxy for long-term U.S. government bonds. |
| `rf` | Derived (continuous) | proportion | Weekly risk-free rate, computed as `(^IRX / 100) / 52` from the annualized 13-week T-bill yield. |
| `SPY_price`, `EFA_price`, `TLT_price` | Continuous | USD | Split- and dividend-adjusted closing price on each weekly return date (last available daily close on or before the date). |

: Variables in the three-asset portfolio data. {#tbl-vars-portfolios-2025}

### Tickers {.unnumbered}

| Ticker | Full name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`SPY`](https://www.etf.com/SPY) | SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust | ETF — U.S. equity | Tracks the S&P 500 index of large-capitalization U.S. stocks; the oldest and one of the largest ETFs, commonly used as a proxy for the U.S. stock market. |
| [`EFA`](https://www.etf.com/EFA) | iShares MSCI EAFE ETF | ETF — international equity | Tracks the MSCI EAFE index of large- and mid-capitalization stocks in developed markets outside North America (Europe, Australasia, and the Far East). |
| [`TLT`](https://www.etf.com/TLT) | iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF | ETF — fixed income | Holds U.S. Treasury bonds with at least 20 years to maturity; essentially free of default risk but highly sensitive to interest-rate movements because of its long duration. |
